items.label: ACT grid ceiling, 8'-0"
items.instanceNote: 🚩 A120 (Rev 4) hatches Ice Machine 139 as ACT grid at 8'-0" (A510.2, also Rev 4, tabulates 8'-0"). The draft carries PT-07 ceiling paint at 8'-0" sourced to A510.2 — but A510.2 tabulates heights only and prints no PT code per its own sheet ('no PT code is given here'), and an ACT lay-in lid is not a painted lid: system conflict unresolved — see report. Also differs from 239/339/439 at 8'-2" on A121–A123 — those sheets are base issue (06/09/23) while A120 is Rev 4 (08/09/24), so the 8'-0" vs 8'-2" split across floors may be the A120-vs-A121–123 revision skew rather than design. Keyed note 5 (CAP-1818 access panel) is placed at the ice alcove on A121–A123 only, NOT on A120.
